dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Wanna team up with me? Huh, I should warn you though, I don't slow down for anyone, greenhorn or otherwise.

choices.text: Jean seems to be pretty reliable.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: With Jean by our side, nothing can stand in our way! ...At least, that's what I wanna say...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: But I can't keep spouting that same old line.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: She always dashes headlong into the heat of the battle, and we want her to take better care of herself.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: I really hope that one day I can look Jean in the eye and tell her she doesn't need to worry anymore, because we have her back...

choices.text: You seem pretty good with a wind glider.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: As a novice within the Knights of Favonius, your understanding of the wind is absolutely crucial.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Leave the advanced wind glider training to me!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Let's all do our best to defeat Stormterror!
